description: Use when you changed or deployed a page and need to know whether it regressed: it compares the live URL with a baseline captured on the first call, a snapshot or a production URL, and answers the regressions. Free up to 40 pages a day per client address, no key needed.

shareToken.description: A share token (dcs_…) the snapshot’s owner issued for agents. Needed unless the account key on the request’s HTTP headers owns or was granted the snapshot.

snapshotId.description: The snapshot id, snap-<uuid>, from the web app or a snapshot listing.

productionUrl.description: A production origin: the page at the same path and query there is Site A.

baseline.description: What to compare against: a saved snapshot ({ snapshotId, shareToken? }) or a production origin ({ productionUrl }). Omit it to use the baseline the first call captured.

checkMode.description: full (existence, content and visual, the default), text-only (no screenshots) or existence-only.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional opaque string a retry repeats: under a prepaid balance the same value within 24 hours is not charged again and answers DUPLICATE_REQUEST with the jobId of the first call.

maxPriceUsd.description: Optional spend cap in USD. A job priced above it is refused before any challenge, so an auto-paying client is never asked for more.

rebaseline.description: Capture a new baseline now instead of comparing with the stored one.

url.description: The live page to check (full URL).

name: check_page
title: Check page
